title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Cayley slices plus source-checked Dedekind and Dirichlet starts
description:
This record is a public-facing shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Arthur Cayley, Richard Dedekind, and P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet. Top-level PDFs are organized by author, work, and usable slice so readers can download individual files directly. Source TeX, build notes, audit outputs, scan witnesses, and provenance material are collected in ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance.

  • Cayley front-facing reader surface: [#---------] 13 volume-level slice readers are promoted as direct top-level files, compiled from the current repaired/retyped source ranges. These are the Cayley files currently suitable as readable mathematical typesettings rather than broad draft material.
  • Cayley broader working material: [#########-] the large artifact ZIP preserves source trees, broad working PDFs, TeX chunks, rendered slice PDFs, and audit material for continuation.
  • Dedekind: [##--------] the latest update adds a source-checked German segment and English translation for Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen through §§1-4, with TeX and scan witness in the compact artifact ZIP. Earlier Band I-III working drafts remain present.
  • Dirichlet: [#---------] the latest update adds a source-checked German edition and English translation of Über die Stabilität des Gleichgewichts, with TeX and source-page witnesses. The older selected-works reader remains a broad working draft rather than the current source of truth.
  • Mathematical proofreading: [----------] working drafts for checking and correction, not certified critical editions.

Workflow. Public-domain scans and witnesses are converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and packaged with source artifacts for inspection and correction. Large raw/provenance material remains on the main project preservation record; this shelf stays reader-facing and comparatively lean.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Focused public-facing working-draft shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet. Latest update adds source-checked Dedekind and Dirichlet starting works while preserving the existing Cayley slice surface and large provenance artifact.
